info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Market Research API
info.description: The Financial Market Research API allows users to submit comprehensive market research requests pertaining to banking and financial data. It empowers financial analysts, investment firms, and market researchers to obtain relevant insights and data necessary for informed decision-making. By utilizing this API, users can accurately gauge market trends and performance indicators, ensuring they remain competitive in the financial landscape. This service is particularly beneficial for enterprises looking to enhance their analytical capabilities and drive strategic investment decisions.

post.description: This operation allows you to generate and submit financial market research data, which can be used for analysis and insights into market trends. Ensure to provide all required data in the request body for successful processing.

requestBody.description: This request body contains parameters required to initiate financial market research. Clients should provide all necessary market data to facilitate the analysis and research process.
